'''Tera Sinube's sabercane''' was a specialized mobility aid that also served the [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] as a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in situations where [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|armed combat]] was the necessary course of action. Designed to be as much of a weapon as a reinforcement for his gnarled frame, Sinube only exposed the duplicity of his [[Sabercane/Legends|sabercane]] when the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|handle]] and collar were separated from the shaft to produce a [[Color/Legends|light blue]] beam of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]. Sinube used his sabercane during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict that pitted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], when he wielded it to great effect against the [[Thief/Legends|thieving]] [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]].

==Description==
[[File:Cosian-LL.png|thumb|left|170px|Sinube utilizing the completed form of his sabercane]]
Due to his age, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] utilized a [[Sabercane/Legends|sabercane]], a specialized device that was both a crutch and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in one.<ref name="CWCE" /> The [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|handle]] of Sinube's sabercane was T-shaped,<ref name="LL" /> and along with the collar, was made of [[Cosian wood/Legends|wood]] from his [[Cosia/Legends|homeworld]]. The [[activation stud]]<ref name="CWCE" /> for the sabercane's [[Color/Legends|light blue]] energy portion<ref name="FB" /> was installed in the handle,<ref name="CWCE" /> and the intricately carved collar connected to a shaft that finished with an enlarged ferrule, the size of which provided increased stability and support for the aged [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] as he moved about.<ref name="LL" /> The rounded ferrule had a flat bottom and four symmetrically placed protrusions to further supplement its owner's stability.<ref name="CWCE" /> In its completed form, the sabercane was roughly half the height of Master Sinube.<ref name="LL" />

[[File:TeraSinubesLightsaberIgnited-LightsaberLost.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Sinube's lightsaber produced a unique bluish-white blade.]]
As [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters advanced in age and became less able to sustain themselves physically, they made use of devices to help lessen the burden on their bodies. In situations where a peaceful approach was less practical and therefore required more aggressive negotiations, some elderly Jedi chose to [[Force weapon|imbue]] their walking sticks with the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], while others abandoned them entirely in favor of lightsabers.<ref name="Choices">[[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] made use of a [[Master Vodo's quarterstaff|Force-augmented walking stick]] in [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''. [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used a walking stick as well, though eschewed it in favor of [[Yoda's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].</ref> Master Sinube, however, fought with both his cane and lightsaber, as they were one and the same. He surprised his opponents, who attacked Sinube as though he was unarmed, by separating the lightsaber from his cane and wielding both parts in concert, with the lightsaber in place as the bladed weapon while the ferrule at the end of the shaft&mdash;which Sinube brandished in a reverse grip&mdash;served as an effective bludgeon.<ref name="LL" />

==History==
[[File:SinubeVsMarcy.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sinube wielding the lightsaber portion of his sabercane while dueling Cassie Cryar]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi investigator/Legends|Jedi investigator]] Tera Sinube utilized his sabercane while on a quest to find the [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|missing lightsaber]] of Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The two Jedi traversed the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and eventually found the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] in possession of Tano's weapon. They were forced to give chase and were able to eventually corner Cryar on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|train]]. When Cryar attempted to attack Sinube with Tano's lightsaber, the Cosian Jedi Master separated the shaft from the handle and collar, from which he then produced his lightsaber blade. Wielding shaft and saber in either hand, Sinube proceeded to battle Cryar with both parts, parrying several of her ripostes with his lightsaber before using the cane extension like a cudgel and striking Cryar in the head with it. The Jedi then retrieved the lightsaber from Cryar, letting the unconscious [[Thief/Legends|thief]] get arrested by the [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]].<ref name="LL" />

[[File:TempleDuelTrainingGround-TWJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Sinube and the younglings witnessing the fierce duel between Skywalker and Offee]]
Later in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict that divided the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in warfare between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Sinube was overseeing a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the [[Jedi Temple training ground/Legends|courtyard]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Padawan [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee's]] [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|duel]] spilled out of the Temple corridors. Sinube drew his sabercane in defense of the younglings and watched as Skywalker subdued the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tera Sinube's sabercane made a brief first appearance along with its owner in the ninth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], titled "[[Grievous Intrigue]]"<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> and released on [[January 1]], [[2010]].<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> In the eleventh episode of the season, "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," Sinube's sabercane was fully featured and was also revealed to be both a lightsaber and a walking stick.<ref name="LL" /> Details for the device were provided with the summer 2010 release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']], which identified Sinube's lightsaber specifically as a "sabercane."<ref name="CWCE" />
